## Summary

Describe the change and its user-facing purpose.

## Related issue

Link the related issue, if one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] Frontend checks listed with results
- [ ] Rust/Tauri checks listed with results
- [ ] Windows manual validation listed, or explained as not applicable
- [ ] Screenshot attached for UI changes, with private data redacted

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credential, local setting, log, or build artifact is included
- [ ] Security/privacy impact is described
- [ ] Upstream-sync impact is described, if applicable

## Reviewer notes

Call out risks, follow-up work, and areas that need focused review.
